Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing bicycle and pedestrian safety education in traffic schools.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to bicycle and pedestrian safety education intraffic schools; adding a new section to chapter 46.82 RCW; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds a number of cities andcounties in the state of Washington conduct traffic schools foreligible persons receiving traffic infractions as a condition of thedeferral of the infractions under RCW 46.63.070(5). The legislaturerecognizes that since driver's education programs have only recentlybeen required to provide information about how to drive safely amongbicyclists and pedestrians, many licensed drivers do not have knowledgeabout such safe driving practices. In order to increase such knowledgeand to avoid unnecessary injuries, fatalities, and conflicts, thelegislature believes that it is appropriate to include bicycle andpedestrian curriculum approved by the department of licensing fortraffic schools or to new drivers as part of the curriculum of trafficschools. Curriculum materials, which are donated by bicycleorganizations without state expense, are available from the departmentof licensing and posted on the department's web site.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.82 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any jurisdiction conducting a traffic school as a condition of thedeferral of an infraction under RCW 46.63.070(5) shall include, as partof its curriculum, the curriculum for driving safely among bicyclistsand pedestrians that has been approved by the department of licensingfor traffic schools. This curriculum addition shall not exceed thirtyminutes of an eighthour curriculum block.
